ground_truth_action: Rollback deployment to commit e3a1c4b and increase JVM heap memory limit from 512Mi to 2Gi

query: What is the standard procedure to rotate the production Vault root token according to the security runbook?
ground_truth_root_cause: N/A - Standard operational runbook query
ground_truth_action: Execute vault operator step-down, generate temporary rotation token with 3-key quorum, and update secret lease

ground_truth_root_cause: HikariCP database connection pool exhaustion (30/30 active connections held by unindexed ledger query)
ground_truth_action: Kill long-running ledger query PID 44102 and increase maximum pool size to 60 with connection timeout of 5000ms

ground_truth_root_cause: N/A - Standard operational runbook query
ground_truth_action: Refer to compliance doc SEC-DR-401: 90 days hot S3, 365 days Glacier, permanent purge at 7 years

ground_truth_action: Route offset past poison pill message 882941 to Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) and apply JSON schema validation patch

ground_truth_root_cause: N/A - Standard operational runbook query

query: ALERT: user-profile service returned HTTP 502 for 100% of ingress requests immediately following v2.4.1 deployment.
ground_truth_root_cause: Container readiness probe failing HTTP GET /healthz on port 8080 due to environment variable REDIS_PORT missing in ConfigMap
ground_truth_action: Inject missing REDIS_PORT: 6379 into ConfigMap user-profile-config and restart deployment rollout

query: What are the mandated PagerDuty escalation timeouts for Tier 1 incidents in prod environments?
ground_truth_root_cause: N/A - Standard operational runbook query
ground_truth_action: Primary on-call has 5 minutes to acknowledge, escalates to secondary at 10 minutes, escalates to engineering director at 15 minutes

query: CRITICAL: checkout-service is throwing RedisCommandTimeoutException on cluster-redis-master.
ground_truth_root_cause: Redis master node CPU pegged at 100% due to KEYS * command executed in automated diagnostic health check cron
ground_truth_action: Kill client executing KEYS * command, replace with SCAN in cron job script, and verify CPU returns below 20%

live_telemetry.last_commit: 5d6e7f8: Add periodic redis key count monitor

query: How frequently must TLS edge certificates be rotated according to the infrastructure security standard?
ground_truth_root_cause: N/A - Standard operational runbook query
ground_truth_action: Let's Encrypt certificates auto-renew every 60 days (90-day expiry); internal CA mTLS certificates rotate every 30 days

query: ALERT: billing-engine database transactions failing with 'deadlock detected: Process 9182 waits for ExclusiveLock on relation accounts'.
ground_truth_root_cause: Concurrent invoice settlement batch workers acquiring locks on customer accounts in opposite order (A->B vs B->A)
ground_truth_action: Enforce deterministic lock acquisition ordering by customer_id ASC in BillingLedger.settle() transaction block

query: CRITICAL: DNS resolution failure across all pods in cluster: Server failure: ns-1.kube-dns.svc.cluster.local.
ground_truth_root_cause: CoreDNS configmap upstream forward loop caused by setting forward . 127.0.0.1 instead of 169.254.169.253
ground_truth_action: Revert CoreDNS Corefile forward directive to AWS VPC DNS resolver 169.254.169.253 and rollout restart coredns deployment

live_telemetry.log_snippet: plugin/loop: Loop (127.0.0.1:53 -> :53) detected for zone ".", see coredns.io/plugins/loop#troubleshooting

query: ALERT: api-gateway throwing HTTP 429 Too Many Requests to mobile app clients despite load being 30% under peak.
ground_truth_root_cause: Redis rate limiter token bucket key collision: all mobile clients hashing to a single static client IP due to X-Forwarded-For stripping at Cloudflare edge
ground_truth_action: Enable 'Use True-Client-IP' in Cloudflare header config and update gateway rate-limiter extractor to use CF-Connecting-IP
